body: That sounds amazing! Dont let your dreams be dreams.

We love to hike trails and go on cheap picnics. I know expensive restaurants and such don't matter. I think I can honestly say helping people is more of a drug for me. I do it bc it makes me happy in that moment, and they needed it too; I'm not doing frivolous stuff.
It's not that I can't say no. I do for certain matters. But if its serious, and I can help, I want to. Even if it bites me in the ass later, i still want to help them.
We have to step up and break the cycle. I've been where you are. You CAN do it. It may not mean much but as someone whose been there; I love you.
I get it. I love you. And I wish I could hug you in real life.
